title: Badki Bhabhi
desc: Kailash Purohit lives in a joint family. Soon, he proposes to break down their house, in order to forge unity amongst his brothers.

title: Saas Kamal Bahu Dhamal
desc: After arriving in a village that has been cursed by a sage, Lakshmi, a well-educated bride, resolves to find a solution.

title: Ek Rajai Teen Lugai
desc: Krishna and Arti love each other and wish to marry. However, an astrologer's unusual prediction prompts Krishna to marry a terminally ill woman to alter his horoscope.

title: Farishta
desc: A father rejects his son with a mental disability and sends him to prison. However, years later the father and son reunite during a troubling time in their lives.

title: Saas Mirchi Bahu Achaar
desc: A family navigates through troubles and deceptions, despite constant bickering. However, constant love and sacrifice help to mend the broken relationships.

title: Jaanam
desc: Vijay and Guru are two men who have different agendas, but their lives get intertwined with each other. While Vijay wants revenge for his late mother, Guru wants to marry Neha against all odds.

title: Bhakti Dhaam
desc: A compilation of uplifting religious melodies and devotional tracks is played back-to-back to create a serene atmosphere for people seeking daily spiritual guidance.
